lines.zh: 我没法走，只能用丝把自己挪一点。
lines.en: I can't walk; I only shift myself on silk.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶边，被风推着晃。
lines.en: I hang at the leaf's edge and swing in the wind.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西在慢慢变。
lines.en: Something inside me is slowly changing.
My silk is stuck along the leaf veins.
I turn half a turn on the leaf.

lines.zh: 丛林的风把我吹得斜了。
lines.en: The jungle wind tips me sideways.
I can't move; I can only wait.

lines.zh: 我外壳里的东西动了动。
lines.en: What's inside my shell shifts.

lines.zh: 叶子上有水，我泡在里面。
lines.en: There's water on the leaf; I'm soaked in it.
One of my threads has loosened.
I hang under the leaf, quite steady.
When I move, the silk whispers.
I pull my weight inward.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，靠着叶柄。
lines.en: I turn slowly to rest against the stem.
I'm under the leaf; the light doesn't reach.

lines.zh: 我又往叶子中间挪了半分。
lines.en: I shift half an inch toward the leaf's middle.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶子下面，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang under the leaf without moving.
My shell hardens day by day.
The wings inside haven't spread yet.
Rain beats the leaf outside.
I can feel the leaf's veins.

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，只是在长。
lines.en: I do nothing but grow.
An ant crawls past.
I keep still and it doesn't notice.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子够我挂到出壳。
lines.en: This leaf will hold me until I emerge.
I settle at a different angle.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，可是你搬不动我。
lines.en: You see me, but you can't move me.

lines.zh: 我黏在叶子上，扯不下来。
lines.en: I'm stuck to the leaf; I won't come loose.

lines.zh: 你伸手来摸，丝会粘住你。
lines.en: Reach for me and the silk will cling.
I'm on the branch above you.
You mean to take the silk, don't you.

lines.zh: 取丝会把我里面的东西弄死。
lines.en: Taking the silk kills what's inside me.

lines.zh: 我不动，你也没法让我动。
lines.en: I'm still, and you can't make me move.
It isn't my time to come out yet.
Just look, don't touch.
Another crack opens in my shell.
Two of my threads have snapped.
I swing badly in the wind.
It hurts, and I can't make a sound.

lines.zh: 我只好更紧地抓住叶子。
lines.en: I can only grip the leaf harder.

lines.zh: 抽我的丝，就等于杀了我。
lines.en: Take my silk and you take my life.
I keep as still as I can.
Wounded like this, I still hold on.

lines.zh: 我连嘴都没有，只等羽化。
lines.en: I have no mouth at all — I only wait to emerge.
My mouth isn't even open.

lines.zh: 这味道我闻得到，可我不需要。
lines.en: I can smell it, and I don't need it.

lines.zh: 你把东西举到我面前，我毫无反应。
lines.en: You hold it before me and I don't stir.
I'm busy with something else inside.
That would rot the leaf.
I'd rather it stayed in your hand.
I wait, and eat nothing at all.
Don't lay it beside me.
I tighten my silk.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下叶子，我就晃。
lines.en: You touch the leaf and I sway.

lines.zh: 被撞得转半圈，丝还挂着。
lines.en: Knocked half a turn; the silk still holds.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我的丝绷得笔直。
lines.en: The leaf swings and my silk pulls dead straight.
I'm still stuck to it.
I hit a vein and stop.
The knock makes my shell sound.
It takes a long time to stop swinging.
I try not to break the threads.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，谈不了这个。
lines.en: In this state, I can't do that.
What's inside is taking shape.
I'll leave that until after I emerge.

lines.zh: 我听见外面有别的蛾翅。
lines.en: I hear other moth wings outside.
I can't answer; I can only wait.
That belongs to the me that flies.
The wings outside fade away.
I draw my silk a little tighter.
Hanging here, I can't be carried off.

lines.zh: 有人扯了一下丝，我晃了晃。
lines.en: Someone tugging the silk makes me sway.
A length of silk is drawn out and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我里面那口气弱了一下。
lines.en: The life inside me dims a little.
I cling harder.
Hands pry at me; I don't budge.
I can't take hold of anything.
I'm under the leaf, hard to reach.

lines.zh: 我被人碰了一下，又放下。
lines.en: Someone touches me and lets go.
I'm still right here the whole time.
Someone keeps looking this way.
I feel warmth approaching.
I pull my silk tighter again.
I can't hide and can't run.

lines.zh: 叶子在抖，是有人在动它。
lines.en: The leaf shakes; someone's moving it.
The wings inside have finished forming.

lines.zh: 我只能把自己缩得更紧。
lines.en: I can only curl tighter.
A hand is reaching in.
I've waited a long while for this.
That hand comes nearer.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到它压着叶子。
lines.en: I feel it press the leaf.
I hang below without moving.
The silk keeps ringing from the touch.
I have no way at all to dodge.

lines.zh: 我在壳里翻身，壳裂了缝。
lines.en: I turn inside the shell and a seam splits.
I'll be ready very soon.
The silk still holds — I can't get out yet.
The leaf starts to bend.
A line splits across my shell.

lines.zh: 我什么都做不了，只能挂着。
lines.en: I can do nothing but hang.
I sway and the silk draws taut.
My shell knocks on the leaf.

lines.zh: 里面的东西被撞得缩起来。
lines.en: What's inside flinches.
One thread snaps; I drop lower.
I grip the leaf vein hard.
I spin in the wind.
I hit the next leaf over.
I can't hold out like this.
I've caught hold once more.
I've formed a cocoon on a leaf.
Silk winds around me, layer on layer.
I'm wrapped up in myself.
The smell of leaves is right outside.
I try to move.
I can't; I can only wait.
The wood is wet and close.

lines.zh: 我听到雨落在别的叶子上。
lines.en: I hear rain on other leaves.
My shell is still soft to the touch.
I hang there, day after day.
Fire reaches me and my shell curls.

lines.zh: 叶子断了，我跟着往下掉。
lines.en: The leaf tears and I fall with it.
Water closes over me completely.
The blast flips the leaf over.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过我的壳。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my shell.

lines.zh: 那道光把丝烧断了一圈。
lines.en: The light burns through a ring of silk.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会耗光。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I can still run out.
The thunder shakes crumbs off my shell.
The leaf is gone and I keep falling.
